messages:
maya: Heads up — RC window closes in ~2.5h. I'm seeing a last-minute fix in feature/kv-stitch that needs a tiny change to release branch. Pinged author for cherry-pick; tagging @eli for fast-approval if needed.
eli: On it. What's the PR? If it's <100 lines we can fasttrack. Also, any changelog impact?
maya: PR: https://git.company/pr/48292 — bugfix for kv cache invalidation. No API change, but could affect latency in edge cases. Suggest one-line changelog: 'fix: kv cache edge-case'.
sam: Can we avoid a full merge? Branch-stitch + patch commit -> cherry-pick to release would be safest. @devon can you do the cherry-pick and smoke?
devon: I can. Two checks: 1) quick CI run (unit + smoke), 2) perf sandbox smoke (~10m). If both green, suggest exception approved. I'll create the cherry-pick PR and tag @ops-sre for rollout window.
ops-sre: Noted. Need confirmation that no rolling restart is required. If this touches runtime config we need a hotpatch window. From quick glance this is code-path only. We can do hotpatch at +3h, fits our window. Please add `#release:hotpatch` label.
maya: Adding label now. devon, please include this checklist in the PR: codeowner approval, CI green, changelog line, and `#release:hotpatch`.
devon: PR created: https://git.company/pr/48293 (cherry-pick of #48292). CI queued. Assigning @eli for codeowner review.
eli: Reviewing now. small nits, nothing blocking. Approving after CI passes. :thumbsup:
release-bot: Deploy window note: RC cutoff at 2965432800. Hotpatch exceptions allowed until 2965434400. Please avoid adding other exceptions.
maya: Great — devon, once CI is green merge and ping @release-team for preflight. Also update changelog PR: https://git.company/pr/changelog-2026, I'll add the line.
devon: CI passed. Merged. Tagging @release-team. Perf sandbox shows no regressions on sample workload.
sam: Copy. Ops, ready for rollout when you are. I'll stand by in #eng-oncall during the patch.
ops-sre: Rolling out now to hotpatch pool, monitoring logs. If errors > 0.5% in 5m window we rollback. :eyes:
release-bot: Hotpatch deployed to 15% of instances. Metrics stable. No action required.
maya: Thanks team — closing exception. Documented in release notes. :party_parrot:
